testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle the preview picture controls before saving: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-saving-source/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:49:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle the preview picture controls before saving ✔ Given the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+S to open Save As ✔ And the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software ✔ And Save Preview Picture is selected ✔ When the user clears Save Preview Picture ✔ Then the preview source choices are hidden ✔ And the preview area displays a placeholder ✔ When the user selects Save Preview Picture again ✔ Then the preview source choices reappear ✔ When the user chooses Active Window on Save ✔ Then that preview source is selected ✔ And Active Component Iso View on Save is not selected ✔ When the user chooses Active Component Iso View on Save ✔ And the user cancels the dialog ✔ Then the unsaved part remains active
